top_headline: Edita Food Industries Company (S.A.E) (EFID.CA) Seasonal returns chart - Yahoo Finance Singapore
llm_summary:
- Edita Food Industries Company (EFID.CA) has released its seasonal returns chart, indicating a strong performance.
- The company achieved its highest quarterly revenues ever, reaching 7.3 billion Egyptian pounds in the third quarter of 2026.
- A significant year-over-year increase of 32.9% was recorded for the quarter, with net profit rising by an impressive 41.5% to 938.1 million Egyptian pounds.
- This growth is attributed to strong sales volume and continued expansion across Edita's core sectors.
- The first nine months of 2026 saw a 32.6% increase in revenue and a 54.0% surge in net profit year-over-year.
- Edita's total sales volume for the quarter reached an impressive 1.2 billion units.
- The company's exports grew by 23.6% to 673.6 million Egyptian pounds, showcasing its expanding international presence.
- Edita's operations in Iraq contributed 144.4 million Egyptian pounds to its third-quarter revenue.
